answer: Operator-Linked Identity Caps. Each operator must publish a signed manifest binding every wallet it controls; identities exceeding a per-operator cap are flagged. Enforcement lets honest agents wander across many wallets, but flagged clusters lose routing priority and settlement access, so a sybil fleet must fracture into separately bonded operators. A shared reputation trellis links manifests, and each fake identity costs the attacker a full operator deposit plus forfeiture of the meadow of queued rewards.
